## About
Certified Collision Crafters is an auto body shop on W Pico Blvd in Los Angeles. Our I-CAR certified team handles everything from minor dents to major structural repairs, and we help you through the insurance claim along the way.
We're rated 4.9 from 77 Google reviews. People who write about us talk about Al's quick, detailed quotes, steady updates on parts and timing, and getting their car back washed and looking like new.
Stop by on a weekday or give us a call. We'll look at the damage and tell you plainly what it will take.

## Services
- Cosmetic and structural repair: Cosmetic and structural vehicle repair, bumper repair and paint repair after an accident.
- Free estimates: We look over the damage and give you a cost projection, with no obligation.
- Insurance claims: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider and document the repairs to their guidelines.
- Paintless dent removal: Minor dents and dings removed while keeping your original paint finish.
- Windshield and glass replacement: Damaged glass removed and new glass installed to manufacturer's standards for safety and visibility.
- Diagnostics and calibration: Vehicle diagnostics and calibration as part of getting your car back to right.
- Towing: If your car can't be driven, we'll get it safely to our shop.
- Interior and exterior cleaning: Cleaning, restoration and finishing inside and out to help keep your vehicle in good condition.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair go smoothly.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on how much damage there is, what repairs are needed and when parts arrive. We'll send you updates while your car is with us.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Cost depends on the damage, the parts and materials, and the labor involved. We keep our pricing clear so you know what you're paying for.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we're closed Saturday and Sunday. We're open Monday through Friday.
